lines.english: It's useless… I won't be able to sleep at this rate.
No matter how hard I try to close my eyes, and no matter how much I try to not think about anything, I can't do anything about how wide awake I am.
The bedside clock shows that it's 8 o'clock. It's 8 o'clock two days after that day, though.
30 consecutive hours of sleep have washed away all of my tiredness from head to toe.
"Aah… ah…"
I shift my gaze to the side, fed up with the view of the well-lit ceiling above me.
Even though I'm aware that a certain person who makes silly noises and lazily tosses and turns on the bed as she's half-asleep isn't here anymore.
And even though I'm aware that the moment I confirm the truth of her absence, my heart will become as cold and heavy as lead.
"Mmph…"
I'm even afraid of checking whether or not I'm crying. This is all I've been doing throughout the winter this year.
I first tried to get out of this state through effort.
I tried to focus my heart and soul on a single task in order to gain the strength I had when I was still my old, healthy self.
Then, I tried to snap out of it without effort.
I simply soaked myself in the fragrant hot water as I melted from its warmth, allowing my cold heart to slowly melt along with it.
And as for the third time…
I can't see what lies at the end of my efforts. The moment I stop trying, I freeze up in the blink of an eye.
It's just… I cannot erase all that I've done to Setsuna.
I've divulged the history I share with Setsuna to another woman. I'm afraid it's inevitable that she'll know about it soon.
Be it from my friends' mouths or my own. …Or perhaps a certain rumor from the theater.
The way I am now, the more I struggle, the more I continue to betray Setsuna, and even if I run away, I'll only end up inevitably hurting her.
"Are you feeling okay?"
"…Sorry."
That's why I've returned to the state I was in the day before yesterday, back when I was unable to bring myself to read Setsuna's text before I fell asleep.
"Even if you put it that way… the screenplay is done and practice has already started."
"No matter how you think of it, you're using a real person as a model. Don't you think that's a violation of privacy?"
"I've read the script and made the necessary considerations. It doesn't seem to include anything besides the trio's relationship."
"Even so… anyone from high school would be able to tell what this is referencing."
"By all means, if you insist, then please take legal action against this. …Although in that case, the person himself must lodge the complaint personally."
"…You think he can do that the way he is right now? The one that's made him fall into such a state is none other than your club member, you know?"
"…If apologizing will solve the problem, then I'll gladly get on my knees. That's why I'd like you to leave the princess… Senouchi alone."
"You… Why are you defending that woman so much?"

"I was deeply fascinated when I watched The Demon of Mt. Uzuki being performed in high school back when I was in my fourth year. I must admit I was really delighted when I heard she was enrolling at this university."
"Huh? You were in your fourth year at that time…"
"Oh, me? I'm in my seventh year now. I'm going to be expelled if I don't graduate this year."
"…Final exams are coming next week, Senpai."
"I found her during orientation and spent half a year persuading her to join."
"Does Senou mean that much to you?"
"She refused the unofficial offer of an up-and-coming company after an audition. It was a close call."
"I've heard about that too… it's a great company. Why did she reject it?"
"The princess is unsuited for a place that's too famous. …Perhaps it's better to say that she'd immediately have a conflict with the higher ups if she went there. This is the best for her."
"You and Senou… no, are you and Izumi going out?"
"Can you detect even the slightest hint of femininity in that monster?"
"Sure, I genuinely adore her merit as an actress, but I wouldn't want to get close to her as a person."
"I-Is that so…"

"She doesn't give a damn about what people say and doesn't budge on her own statements, and she has the last word on everything from the programs to the cast and schedule. She's a demon on stage, but she's a red panda outside of it."
"…Just like back in the old days."
"People are seeing my role as president as more of a name rather than respecting the managerial position that comes with it."
"…Let's go for a drink sometime, Mr. President."
"Thank you for your patience. Here's the Napolitan pasta, mixed pizza, and egg sandwich…"
"Ah, put it all over here. Oh, and hurry up with the banana parfait."
"…R-Right away. Please enjoy your meal."
"Yay, the food's here～! Well, time to eat!"
"Mm… nn, am… pardon me for eating, Mizusawa-san."
"…Someone's got a big appetite for this time of the day."
"I've been like that ever since I started practicing. No matter how much I supply myself with energy, I use it all up in the end."
"True enough, in the couple of times I've seen you on stage back in high school, you were really energetic."
"I remember losing ten kilos when I was acting once. I had to eat a lot for three days to fill myself back up."
"…That might be even worse than doing sports. Even I haven't lost that much weight when I had matches."
"I've also watched a lot of matches from the basketball club. The stage is closed off during official matches, so I couldn't get any practice."
"Ah, I see. Thanks, I guess."
"Mmm… mnn… mm…"
"…Mmmgh, mmgh…"
"…Well?"
"Eh?"
"If you want to talk to me about something, do it soon. At this rate, I'm going to finish eating in ten minutes, you know?"
"A-Ah… I'm sorry."
"No need for apologies. At any rate, I presume you're here to start a fight, right?"
"…Mmmg… mmh…"
"Well, I'll cut to the chase with no reservations now, Izumi Chiaki-san."
"That's a bit formal, isn't it? We've already known each other for six years. …Though we've hardly spoken to each other during that period, I guess."
"This is about Haruki, isn't it? How very thoughtful of you, Mizusawa Io-san."
"Exactly. What exactly do you even think of Haruki…?"
"I love him. I really love him. Why would I have slept with him otherwise?"
"What's wrong? Did you want me to say 'As if I'd like a guy like him,' or something like that?"
"T-That's…"
"'I only used Haruki for the sake of my own drama.' Did you want me to laugh out loud while saying that?"
"Mm… Ah, excuse me～ I'd like to add on a vegetable omelette, please～"
"…Excuse me?"
"That's right. It was the princess who spread Todokanai Koi throughout the university."
"Senou did…?"
"She spread it amongst the broadcasting circle. She hoped that when her play finally became a reality, the whole university would be familiar with that song by then."
"I see… I've always wondered where the sound source got leaked…"
"I heard she got approval from those concerned."
"That would be me…"
"…Ah, I got the license to use that song, you know! I've already confirmed this with the high school, and they told me that there was no problem using it in Houjou University…"
"The one who gave permission for that was me. …The other three had long since relinquished their rights to it."
"In any case, the princess is wagering everything on the next public performance. After all, she's been carefully planning this for three years now."
"I didn't expect her to be this serious…"
"She's so engrossed in this next performance that she thinks nothing about having to lie and hurt someone else for the sake of it."
"She's deceived and hurt him terribly enough."
"…Although, it's possible that it might bite her in the back."
"She doesn't care about it at all, does she? I don't see that happening in this case."
"Perhaps that's for the best."
"As if."
"The princess has been their crazy fan for three years, you know?"
"I know the extent of what an excessively crazy fan is capable of doing after having witnessed all this."
"To ruin their relationship in order to present said relationship on stage… What sense of accomplishment would the princess get from that?"
"How about it? Can you solve this contradiction?"
"…Like I'd know."
"Haaaah… that was a great meal～ Mmm, I'll work hard today too!"
"Well then, that's all for my errands. I should be getting back to the clubroom now."
"…Wait."
"Hmm～?"
"I told you to wait, you hear me?"
"…Have I not answered your questions earlier?"
"Who in their right mind would be satisfied with answers like that…?"
"…If you can't accept those answers, why not just make up your own? It's not like I have any rebuttals, you know?"
"If you really love him, how could you have done such cruel things to him…?"
"For the record, I was the first one, you know? I managed to give him everything he so desired, didn't I?"
"Or is it that you think that loving a person while deceiving them with lies is contradictory?"
"After all, you didn't lie to him because you loved him, right? You were lying only to get close to him right from the start, weren't you?"
"And what of it?"
"At the very least, whatever you've done has deeply hurt Haruki. What right do you have to say that you love him now…?"
"Huh. Then Ogiso-san has no right either. She was the one who hurt Haruki from the start, after all."
"What I've done is comfort Haruki after he'd been wounded by her, protecting him from breaking down… and even then, I'm the only culprit here?"
"Your motive is preposterous!"
"The fact remains that I was the one who saved Haruki."
"But you ruined it all in the end. Whatever you did was all for nothing."
"…Aren't you guys the ones who ruined it this time?"
"What did you say!?"
"If you guys didn't butt in unnecessarily into this, if Haruki continued to be blissfully unaware of my true identity, don't you think he would've recovered eventually?"
"Y-You… What are you…"
"If that were the case, Haruki and Ogiso-san would've reconciled. And he'd have probably completely forgotten about what happened with me too."
"Wait… Hey!"
"The people who have wasted this golden opportunity are none other than Iizuka-kun and… yourself, Mizusawa-san."
"…You …You don't understand anything. How could you possibly… understand anything about them?"
"So you're saying you understand, huh?"
"I'm sorry for what I've done. Here's the payment for the bill as an apology."
"You're a lifesaver. My food budget's tight during this period."
"…! …See you."
"Noisy outsider."
"Haruki～! Come over here～!"
I can't…
No matter how much I clean it with the vacuum cleaner or wipe it with a cloth, I've yet to see any improvement.
…This is the third time I'm cleaning up today, though, so it's only natural that I can't expect things to be cleaner than they already are.
Feeling resigned by the futility of it all, I sit before the table where my textbooks and reference books are set out in preparation for the test next Monday.
I pick up one of the books and look for the pages with the exercises.
"Like I said, don't worry about all that stuff. You don't have to do anything."
…I should've gone to work.
The decision to take leave from my part-time jobs when there's still a week before exams arrive was a fatal mistake.
I've already reviewed everything the exam would cover. And it's not just for the exams on the first dayーI've already revised all of my subjects.
I'd really like to go through my exams earlier if I could, given that I can't forget everything I've studied.
…No, it's actually okay if I forget. That would mean I get to study again. It would allow me to put my mind to work while not thinking about anything, as contradictory as it sounds.
"Things will change. Even if you don't do anything, Haruki, time will change everything."
There's nothing left that I can do. I've already finished my laundry long ago as well.
I've already finished all of the chores that can be done in this confined room within half a day.
I'll only continue to think about things I don't want to if I laze around idly like this. That's why I need to keep myself busy no matter what.
My sleepiness has long since left me. This is what I get for forcing myself to sleep for more than ten hours a day since that day, even though my sleeping hours are usually short.
Besides, what's the point if I can't really cheer up by sleeping…?
"So for now… you don't need to act or think. Just wait patiently for time to resolve everything."
"Shut up!"
That's not true… There is no way it could be true.
"The doors are about to close for Line 2. Please be careful."
The train left Minami-Suetsugu at 20:08. In other words, this train in particular departs from Suetsugu-chou at 20:10, heading toward Onjuku.
…It will arrive at Iwazu-chou at 20:15.
It seems that the trains are still running on the same schedule.
It's the train I boarded together with Kazusa for the first time after practicing for the school festival…
As I obsess over emotions that are utterly meaningless to me now, I sit on a bench and gaze at the people heading toward the ticket gate.
I passed through the ticket gate aimlessly, simply standing still on the station platform.
More than ten trains have passed by since I've arrived and more than a hundred passengers have walked by me.
I feel helpless. After all, I had no destination right from the start.
It's just that I couldn't tolerate the presence of the lingering odor of a certain someone back in my apartment.
"The train has arrived on Line 1. Please stand behind the yellow line."
I've grown tired of running away from reality for these three days.
Even if I try to shut my eyes and go to sleep, I'd only wake up without anything to do and find myself staring at the ceiling again.
…The shock I received back then was so large that I wasn't able to do anything for a while, and not to the point where I could run out of patience.
Even so, given my own fussy disposition, it took me 72 hours before I was finally fed up with loitering around in a daze all by myself.
From there on out, I started actively running away.
I cleaned up the apartment, did the laundry, and studied for my exams. I did my best to do things that demanded physical and mental activity in order to pass the time without thinking about anything.
After the next three days, I finally completely lost sight of what I should be doing and went out into the streets, wanting to distract myself with the hustle and bustle of a crowded place.
"Minami-Suetsugu, Minami-Suetsugu. Please mind your step as the doors open when you disembark the train."
Two hours after that…
The sun has fully set, and the chilly air from the day has now become a penetrating cold that freezes to the core.
My breath is white, the tip of my nose is icy, and my extremities have gone numb. From head to toe, the very climate of winter toys with my body.
I've cornered myself in such a miserable situation, but despite how obviously absurd it may seem, I've finally come to a realization.
The fact that Chiaki's betrayal is excruciatingly painful.
It's disheartening, to the same degree as when Setsuna and I parted from one another.
"The doors for Line 1 are closing. Please be careful."
I met her half a year ago, and she decided to get close to me one-sidedly. She would often be met with sermons from me whenever she found an opportunity to exploit me.
The circumstances, the attitude, the way we were stuck with each other's companyーit was all too convenient for us to get closer to each other.
I curse whatever powers above may be that are responsible for this, but the sigh that escapes my mouth does nothing but rise gently into the sky.
But in reality, it's got nothing to do with the work of a higher power. It was the result of a performance by a single prodigy of an actress.
"Let's fall into depravity together, okay?"
"Just shut up…"
I've already been corrupted much like she's suggested, but I won't be able to see her arrive no matter how long I wait in the deepest depths of hell.
And yet, to think that I'm miserable because she isn't here by my side right now instead of the fact that I was tricked…
I'm an even bigger fool than she is, aren't I?
The people that disembark the train trail out through the exit gates, bringing a temporary silence to the platform yet again.
"…I should head home."
After about two hours, and having had my fill of this mix of noise and silence, I stand up and trail after the backs of all those other people rushing on their way home.
No sooner after I received my baptism that consisted of sitting still for more than two hours did I find myself sitting on the bench again.
The oxygen in my brain fades in an instant and the color from my view disappears, followed by a fade to black.
"Haha…"
I can't help but laugh at myself for how stereotypical it is to get dizzy from standing up too fast.
Since there's no helping it, I close my eyes and look upward while taking in the darkness, trying to rush the blood back to my head.
That way, the vertigo will slowly settle down and I should regain my ability to see normally.
"…Ah… Huh?"
But after a few minutes pass, I realize this isn't a simple case of lack of oxygen in the brain.
What the heck… my body's collapsing on me. I'm just being done in by the cold.
Or it's actually because the balance between my heart and my body had already broken down a while ago.
"Hah… haha…"
Realizing that, I feel the scornful laugh I aimed toward myself just now turning into a smile of reassurance.
That's convenient… at least this way my mind will start to go numb.
…I'll be able to forget about her for a while.
"Mm…"
"Ah, hah…"
I reach for my cell phone beside my pillow in a daze, my entire body as fatigued as always.
After struggling to get back home after that, I collapsed onto my bed…
After that, the day seemed to pass into Sunday somehow, and enough time has passed to the point where it's now already a time where it's almost noon.
During that entire time, besides getting up to quench my thirst, I'd succumbed to the dreamless sleep that I'd always been hoping for."
"Yes…"
"Ah, he's on…"
"Of course I'd be on the line of my own cell phone. Did you deliberately waste my precious phone battery just to confirm that?"
Recently, I've been ignoring calls for the past ten days, but my tone comes out in a brazenly off-handed manner.
"…You seem well."
Perhaps it's because this strange feeling of comfort that I haven't had in a while is interrupted that a slight irritation rises up from the depths of my dazed consciousness.
"As if I'm feeling well… My head still feels dizzy. And my fever hasn't gone down yet…"
Muttering that, at the same time I raise my hand to my forehead and shake my head, trying to check my own status.
…And, to nobody's surprise, it's exactly as I said, my fever hasn't gone down yet.
I don't really want to think about my current situation and how I have to tackle things like final exams starting tomorrow. Although I was grateful for it up until now…
"Aah, so that's how it is."
"What?"

"You didn't come for the English History exam today, right? Considering you're always attending even the lectures that don't take your attendance, to skip a test would be quite daring of you, I'd say."
"…Hold on. What day is it today?"
If I'm remembering correctly, English History should be on… "the second day."
The phone call with my seminar colleague reveals that it's been three days since that night somehow.
Meaning that I collapsed on Saturday night and was stuck in bed with that nightmare until noon on Tuesday… No, I was actually just fast asleep.
I measured my temperature to discover that it was exactly 39°C. Why haven't I recovered at all despite resting for so long…?
"Normally when you catch a cold, you would get plenty of sleep, take it easy, take your medicine… and stay put until your body heals, right?"
And I did exactly what you said. I slept properly, took it easy, and took my medicine…
I'm forgetting something, aren't I? I'm such an idiot.
After exhausting myself like that, how can I even think about recovering without proper nourishment?
I haven't been eating anything for the past few days…
"…There you have it. That makes three subjects he's flunked thus far."
"Hmm…"
"Geh, that's just cold, man. And to think I called him in your stead for you."
"Ah～ sorry for the trouble, I guess."
"Why can't you just call him yourself, anyway? Aren't you guys dating or something?"
"That doesn't really matter. It's just that I wondered what was going on since he was absent during an exam."
"That's it? You're not worried at all?"
"I am worried, but this isn't really the time to be worried."
"Well, I guess so. Compared to Kitahara who can advance to the next grade even if he flunks all his subjects, if you make a single mistake, Izumi…"
"Like I care about getting into the next grade anyway."
"Hmm?"
"Oh, it's nothing, thanks. Well then, I'll go home now."
"Ah, hey, wait…"
"…Heh."
"Oh dear, oh dear～ You're really naive, aren't you, Haruki? It's not like I said I'd dump you or anything～"
"I'd appreciate it if you didn't make me worry so much. I'm at the most important step right now."
"I'm sorry, but I can't come over to warm you up now, okay, Haruki?"
"…What am I saying. I suppose you're the one who's turned me down, huh?"
"Pasta, retort curry, instant yakisoba, crackers, canned food, mineral water… and some seasoning."
After despairing over the fridge that only contained drinks, I searched the bottom drawer of the tableware cabinet as a last hope and thankfully found some food I've stashed away for an emergency.
However, I'm currently faced with food that only someone healthy would be able to appreciate despite being sick.
Dried noodles, stimulants, heartburn-inducing foods, insipidly dry pieces… my currently feeble digestive system isn't capable of accepting any of those right now.
"Aah…"
The moment I consider the thought of heading to the convenience store, my body languidly collapses as if to refuse the idea, miserably slumping itself onto the floor.
In my current state, I'd probably need an ambulance before I'd even reach the apartment building's gate.
That's why the amount of energy it would take to cook by myself at home would probably be more dangerous.
Even so, if I'm going to continue sleeping without eating anything like this, judging by how I've been for the last three days, I'm not going to get any better.
"…Okay."
After several seconds of hesitation, a wise saying flashes inside my head.
"You won't be troubling anyone even if you've fallen sick at your own home."
…Although it's quite probable that I'm unable to make a rational decision in my feverish state right now, I resolved myself to first figure out a way to get through my hunger with my own strength.
And yet the moment I start thinking about what to do next, in the end, I can only repeat my sighs of hopelessness from a few seconds ago.
Pasta, retort curry, instant yakisoba, crackers, and canned food.
In the end, ingredients that were suitable for cooking weren't available in the first place.
If I'm going to make something that's at least somewhat edible out of all this, it could only be spaghetti or rice mixed with canned food…
"…That's it."
At that moment, my head formulated the thought of a dish meant for the sick that's just a little irregular.
"Okay, we're about to start. Gather around, everyone!"
"I'm sorry to call you all here in the middle of exams. However, there's only a month until our first public performance. We can't waste a single second from here on out."
"Anyway, for today we'll go through the first scene. Yoshida… I'm counting on you, okay?"
"…Got it. I read the script thoroughly today before arriving."
"Senouchi, you got anything to say?"
"Princess?"
"…Ah, eh?"
"I asked if you had anything to say."
"Ah, aah… that's… let's see, when you guys act, I want you to be mindful of…"
"…Haaah."
"What's wrong?"
"…Sorry, but I'm not in the mood today. Tell everyone to do solo practice instead."
"Huh…?"
"H-Hey… Princess?"
"President…"
"Haha… hahahaha, well, let the solo practice begin♪!"
"As if anyone would go on like that～!"
Three cups of water. Soy sauce, sake, salt, and dashi stock.
It'll be okay to use canned food for the main ingredient. However, I can't have the flavor be too strong.
By adding some pasta sauce, it'll have the nice flavor of a risotto.
After the rice has been cooked, I'll boil the water, add the ingredients, simmer them until soft, before turning off the gas and cracking in an egg…
A hot vapor drifted in the air around the stove that I turned off in a panic.
But there was no smell to it, just the odorless steam that comes from the evaporation of hot water.
Despite how the heat's been turned off, the inside of the pot is hot enough to cause the water to froth and overflow.
"That was close…"
It looks like the pot was just left boiling on its own for the same amount of time I cooked in my dream.
…While I was exposed to the steam and dozed off.
What I'm left with is an even greater fatigue and the sensation of emptiness in my stomach that goes hand in hand with an appetite.
Together with the overflowing sweat from my body, I feel like the small amount of physical strength I have left is being completely stripped away.
This… could be genuinely really bad. It's at the level where I have to seriously consider being taken away by an ambulance.
It seems like my body's become weak lately. Or maybe it's my heart that's gone weak?
Or perhaps… I'm getting what I deserve?
Did I end up getting betrayed because I betrayed someone myself?
Have I been so incapable of helping others because all I've done is wait for others to help me?
What the hell… In the end, this is all my fault, isn't it?
"Would you like your bento to be heated up?"
"Ahh, please just heat it up a little bit. This is for a sick person, so please be careful with it."
"…Understood. …One kakiage tendon and katsu curry, that will be a total of 1120 yen, please."
"Oops…"
"I'm sorry… for coming so suddenly."
I'm unquestionably hallucinating right now.
Usually, when the doorbell rings, I'd always check who my guest is through the intercom.
"I heard that you weren't there for your exam today, Haruki-kun. That's why I called the laboratory."
"Why…?"
As I thought, I'm unquestionably hallucinating right now. What am I doing, blurting out an answer for a question that hasn't even been asked yet?
"I'm glad I came here…"
"Setsuna… you shouldn't be doing this. What if you get infected?"
"Gulp…"
But right now, the intensity in Setsuna's eyes is definitely not a hallucination, now that I think about it.
"Go back to bed right now."
"I'm having a guest here, though…"
"Anyone in their right mind who saw you like this would know that this isn't the right time for formalities like that, Haruki-kun."
"Ah…"
Setsuna shows a rare expression and tone of anger.
"Why won't you get some proper rest…? Any way you look at it, you're already struggling to even stand."
"No, I was lying in bed the whole time. It's just that I had to make something to eat…"
"…Mmm."
"…Sorry."
However, I notice a slight hint of Setsuna's teary expressionーsomething which is very characteristic of her.
"If it's a meal you want, I can make it for you. …Porridge will do, right?"
As I obediently go back to my bed, Setsuna unpacks the ingredients one by one from the shopping bag she's holding in her hand.
They don't seem to be portions meant for a person or two, but rather a large variety that can sustain a single person for a week.
After placing these items in the fridge and arranging them, Setsuna finally turns her attention to the messy kitchen that I was in earlier…
"Ah…"
And her gaze stopped there.
On the soup boiling in the pot and the can of vongole I left next to it.
"That's, well… there's just a little bit of rice left."
"This is something that can be made by someone who can't cook. It's not exactly something that someone who can't move from their illness can make, you know?"
"…Mmm."
Setsuna still remembers.
Three years ago, the single dish that Setsuna taught me how to make. The only dish I had ever made for Kazusa…
"Really, I'm so glad I came. I'm really glad that I decided to come…"
"Setsuna…"
That was the face and voice that I had been waiting for for almost a month.
It's been a month since I looked at her teary eyes and listened to her sob her heart out as she reprimanded me.
"I'll wake you up when I'm done, so try and get some rest, okay?"
"Yeah…"
I wonder why my gaze is unable to leave Setsuna's back even after I nodded in return…
"You shouldn't feel glad that you've come here."
"You're not supposed to be able to bring yourself to forgive me."
"I've committed a new sin against you, you know?"
"Do you know that I'm still betraying you even now, Setsuna?"
Those are words that I absolutely have to tell her, but I'm only capable of sealing them inside right now.
While Setsuna isn't looking, I burn the sight of Setsuna's figure that I've not seen for a long time deep into my eyes.
And I line up convenient excuses like getting carried away because of my fever.
"Eat slowly, okay? It's still steaming hot, after all."
"Fuu～ Fuuuu～"
What Setsuna had prepared for me was simple, a light porridge mixed with cabbage and other vegetables like chives, something that would be easy for me to digest.
…Come to think of it, is this small bit that I'm tasting in my mouth a clam from the vongole sauce?
"Can you eat this?"
"Yeah…"
I've been waiting for solid food for almost a week, but given how this is gently cooked, it slides down my throat smoothly.
"Eat slowly and as much as you can, okay?"
"Yeah…"
My concerns of my stomach's vehement rejection of her food have thankfully been baseless. Contrarily, my stomach's starting to work properly, slowly satisfying my intense hunger.
"It's okay if there are leftovers. You can keep them in the fridge and all you have to do is 'ding it' and…"
"Eh…"
"F-Forget I said that! 'Ding it' is a phrase my mom uses a lot. Oh dear, it's getting to me…"
"Aha…"
"D-Don't laugh at me… Even I know I sound like an old granny right now."
"My bad… ah!"
As I carelessly take another sip of the porridge, the heat in my mouth starts to sting as if to punish me for laughing at her.
And yet, this stinging sensation is one that brings back memories, and regardless of how painful the heat in my mouth is, my spoon isn't stopping in delivering portions of porridge into my mouth.
"Why didn't you call anyone about this?"
"…M-My bad."
"Me aside, you could've asked Io or Takeya for help. Any of us would come over and help you out, you know?"
Perhaps Setsuna's starting to reprimand me a little because she feels slightly more at ease upon seeing me eating properly.
"I've been asleep during the day. The few times I've managed to wake up were during the middle of the night. I didn't want to trouble anyone by calling that late…"
"It's not a problem at all. Didn't we use to call each other at 3 AM in the middle of the night just fine?"
"That's…"
"Personally, I think it hurts more to hear that the past was more painful and harsh than the present, you know?"
"…I don't understand your roundabout way of saying that."
"I see you've finally rebutted me, Haruki-kun."
"Rest up well tomorrow as well, okay? You're forbidden from going to university or working part-time until you fully recover."
"If I do that, my exams… I can't advance to the next grade like that."
"Instead, you should head to the hospital to pick up a medical certificate. That way the teachers will probably consider letting you take the exams."
"Is that so?"
"You have a high enough attendance rate anyway, Haruki-kun, so that's fine. …Or is it that you can't take my word for it?"
"It's not like that…"
"Will it be troublesome to go to the hospital by yourself? Perhaps I should go with you, then?"
"It's fine… You have exams too, don't you, Setsuna?"
"I've already safely gone through my exams yesterday. I'd say I also did a decent job on the French test, which I thought would be the most difficult for me."
"I see."
"Let's get into the next grade together, okay? And… let's graduate together as well, alright?"
I can't give a proper reply due to my fever right now.
But the heat of the porridge that I'm putting into my mouth right now hurts, causing tears to leak from my eyes.
"Want seconds?"
"…Yeah."
I'm immediately appeased by Setsuna's kind sermons that are different from my own, just like how I was satisfied with the porridge she made.
Her sermons are entirely kind to the very end and you can feel the warmth permeating from them, unlike the pushy sermons I give.
That's why I sealed away my words that were meant to convey that I didn't contact anyone because I didn't want her to know about this.
The fact that I'm giving a shock to Setsuna, as well as the fact that I'm making the atmosphere awkward for both of us is really agonizing with the way I am now.
"I've made you enough food for three days, make sure to ding… heat it up before eating, okay?"
"Thank you… you're a lifesaver."
Setsuna's been in my apartment for almost an hour now since then.
She quickly cooks the ingredients she brought over, wraps it up, packs it all into tupperware, and stuffs everything one by one into the refrigerator and the freezer.
"The ingredients and technique I used weren't out of the ordinary, so I won't make any guarantees about how it'll taste, okay?"
"Really, thank you so much… Setsuna."
"H-Hey, that's not really a response, Haruki-kun…"
"Ah, aah…"
Even if I compare this to the cooking I treated Kazusa to three years prior, there's definitely been enough improvement in these three years that I can grasp it.
So the taste is obviously better than it was before, and out of consideration for my feeble health right now, there's no doubt that it's properly taking balanced nutrition into account.
"Well then… I'll get going soon. If I stay here any longer, it would tire you out unnecessarily, so…"
"Ah…"
She came over and cooked for me when I couldn't make a meal for myself. On top of that, she went out of her way to make pre-made meals for me.
Setsuna has also been incredibly kind to me; so kind in fact that she felt it was only natural for her to come and finish her role.
And yet…
My body's rejecting the imminent state of being alone again.
"You know you have to take your medicine before sleeping, right? Your fever hasn't even gone down, so don't you dare think about doing anything like going to university, okay?"
"Ah, yeah…"
Setsuna's back is faced toward me as she puts on her boots.
I extend an undeserving hand toward her back in my heart.
Maybe, just maybe…
If I were to hug Setsuna from behind right now… If I hugged her and cried my heart out right now…
Would Setsuna gently return my embrace in response?
Or would she push me away in annoyance, saying that we're past the point of no return?
"Bye."
"…Bye."
Who am I kidding. It's not like I could ever do something so forcefully selfish to Setsuna.
Even though I've made a mess out of a certain other someone as much as I pleased. And even though I never even bothered to consider whether she'd hate me for doing it.
Is it because Setsuna is special to me…?
"Hey, Haruki-kun."
"Eh…"
"Thank you… for letting me into your apartment again."
And this time, I don't want to do it from behind; I'm compelled to embrace her directly from the front.
It wouldn't be a surprise attack; it would be an attempt to ascertain her true feelings head-on.
I'd ask her why she decided to come here today. I'd ask her to forgive me.
I'd ask these as the person who continuously avoided her while harboring pain and sorrow for three years. I'd ask these as someone who lied to her and ended up hurting her even more just a month ago.
"…I can't see myself fastening a lock meant to keep you out, Setsuna, much less install it."
"Really, thank you very much… Haruki-kun."
"That's not really a response…"
"It is…"
…I'd ask these as someone who betrayed her a month ago, and as someone who's currently receiving my just desserts because I only thought of seeking help for myself.
That's why I…
If Setsuna has truly forgiven me, do I have the right to fully embrace her right now?
Forcibly, intensely, overbearingly… with the strength that ensures that we would never be torn apart again, even if she would break into tears as I do so.
Do I have the right to do so? Should I do so? …Do I want to do so?
"You know, Setsuna…"
"Hmm…?"
What I've decided to do to Setsuna is…
"Ah…"
"Hey, what a coincidence."
"Shouko-san…"
"Going home after visiting a guy?"
"Eh?"
"No need to hide it～ You live in a standalone house, don't you, Setsuna? This is an apartment building, though."
"Ah, that's… What are you doing here, Shouko-san?"
"Me? I'm just on the way home after buying dinner."
"Oh, so you live in this neighborhood."
"Perhaps."
"What do you mean, perhaps…?"
"Right, wanna have some bento together? I kinda bought too much."
"Here, you okay with black coffee?"
"Ah, thank you…"
"…Was it really that hard to dig in?"
"Katsu curry is… quite heavy, isn't it?"
"You didn't have to force yourself to eat it all."
"My parents always told me that I shouldn't leave behind any food on a plate served to me."
"So you're a good girl, Setsuna. And you always seemed to be since you were a child."
"You think so? I'd think that it's my family that's good rather than me."
"The fact that you can say things like that so naturally is impressive."
"Gulp… Haah, it's warm."
"I bet the bento's already gone cold too～"
"Umm… I guess so."
"…Isn't it great?"
"Eh? What is?"
"That your efforts have finally paid off. …You've reconciled with your boyfriend, right?"
"…What makes you think that?"
"Well, it's because I coincidentally saw you come out from his apartment."
"That's… just because he got sick and collapsed. Apparently, he couldn't even make food for himself."
"I see, good for you, then. It's the perfect opportunity for you to see him when he's so vulnerable, right?"
"That really wasn't my intention…"

"I imagine he's weak to women who are kind to him when he's in a rough spot. It doesn't matter who it'd be during such a time for him… No, it's because it's you who's the one being so kind to him that he's like that, Setsuna."
"…Shouko-san?"
"How should I put this… it's a little disappointing. I've fantasized about what your boyfriend's like, Setsuna."
"Imagine?"
"That man must truly be a wonderful person from the bottom of his heart if he's managed to make you fall in love with him, Setsuna. I made my own ideal image of him just like that."
"Though if you look a little deeper, he's actually blind to his own misgivings and ends up relying on you, Setsuna."
"From the way you described him, I thought he was someone who's incredibly honest and serious to the point where he keeps driving himself into a corner."
"You describe him as if you've met him before."
"Ah, sorry, did I offend you? I'll apologize, then."
"It's not like I'm mad or anything… it's just, you describe him so precisely…"
"It's nothing like that, it was just my imagination running wild. But it's fine, if you're satisfied, Setsuna, then we'll leave it at that. I think it's a bit of a shame, though."
"Was it disappointing?"
"Well, it's not that, but it didn't meet my expectations. I figured I'd drag it out until the spring."
"You said something like that at some point earlier, didn't you? Is there something special about spring?"
"Well, it was part of the schedule, after all."
"…Schedule?"
"It's the time of year that warms you up and lifts your spirits up, after all!"
"Is that so…"
"Well, never mind all that. I wish you two happiness. Well, then, I should be heading home now."
"Can we meet again?"
"Who knows? If your problems have been resolved, there's no reason for me to be around you anymore, right?"
"Then why don't we talk a little more today? Or are you tired of listening to me?"
"If I hear more about your little love story I'd be…"
"Can't you? 'Izumi Chiaki-san.'"
"That's… the correct way of addressing you, if I may?"
"…What do you know, so you knew all along. You're a bad girl, 'Ogiso-san.'"
"No, I just put it together now."
"What gave me away?"
"The fact that you were waiting seemingly naturally outside the apartment building."
"I told you it was a coincidence."
"You have two bentos. And they were both cold."
"I also said I just bought too much. That, and what does the fact that the bentos were cold have to do with…"
"You took the trouble to come and visit, but because I was already inside, you couldn't come in, right? …To Haruki-kun's apartment, I mean."
"…Or I just wanted to take these home to heat them up."
"That might be the case too. So which exactly is the truth?"
"…You heard it from Mizusawa-san, didn't you? About my real name, I mean."
"Not at all. Neither Io nor Takeya-kun have told me anything about it."
"Heh… is that so. And to think that they've already told Haruki…"
"Well, that's because it only concerns you and Haruki-kun, am I wrong?"
"…I don't really get what you're saying."
"I'm talking about how the problems between Haruki-kun and me… have nothing to do with you."
"Ah, I see."
"I learned about you from Haruki-kun just a short moment ago, Chiaki-san. Though at the time I didn't know he was talking about you, Shouko-san…"
"Even so, who would've imagined that that horrible actor would voluntarily ruin everything for himself by exposing everything that's been going on behind the scenes…"
"It's really not like that…"
"How much have you already heard about me? How much have you heard about the atrocities I've committed?"
"…He said nothing about that. He just said something about you saving him when he was in pain."
"…How very fair of him. No, how very unfair to himself."
"No doubt that he has a side like that, that Haruki-kun. Sometimes I think it'd be great if he actually tried to stand up for himself."
"You're right, it'd be nice if he'd actually defend himself sometimes, huh? …He has every right to collapse and agonizingly weep over being deceived and used by an outrageous woman."
"Fine, I'll tell you all about it. I'll tell you what I've done to him… and how I ended up ruining everything after that."
"Chiaki-san…"
"I may sound theatrical when I tell you about all this, but do pardon me. After all, this is my actual profession."
"Senou-san… from the Theater Club?"
"It's really nostalgic, isn't it, Ogiso-san? We haven't seen each other since that graduation ceremony, have we?"
"I've heard of you… If I remember correctly, you've been hogging all the lead roles for the school festival since we were first-year students, right?"
"And you didn't realize it at all, did you? My true identity, that is."
"I'm sorry… you really gave off a completely different image when you were on stage."
"Ah, that's actually wrong by a long shot. I'm not just different in terms of how I am on stage and outside of it. All of my identities are different people."
"…What do you mean?"
"The 'Nagase Shouko' that you've spoken to, the 'Izumi Chiaki' that followed Haruki around, and the 'Senouchi Akira' that Watos flaunts as their pride and joy… are all different personalities."
"Eh…"
"Much like how I single-handedly played the roles of the characters in Yuutsuru I performed in the middle school competition and The Four Kashiwagi Sisters during the high school festival."
"Chiaki-san…?"
"Very soon, I'll be adding two more to my repertoire… and they're none other than 'Ogiso Setsuna' and 'Touma Kazusa'. Well, I had to change the names of these characters, though."
"Do you resent me now? Do you think I'm unforgivable?"
"…Why are you painting yourself in such a bad light? Is that also part of the role you're playing right now?"
"Not really～? All I've done is calmly and objectively analyze what I've done, you know?"
"Do you know that Haruki pushed me down? He wanted to hit me, but he couldn't bring himself to do it since I'm a woman, and he remained on top of me while bawling his eyes out."
"There it is, you're finally getting worked up. I really wouldn't mind it if you decided to slap me right now, you know?"
"…Why are you putting on such an obvious act?"
"It is an act, yes… but when you say it's so obvious, it kinda hurts my feelings. Well, I'm not proud of it, but…"
"But Chiaki-san… No, Shouko-san… you were so happy back then, weren't you?"
"Huh? When are you referring to?"
"At the beginning of winter break… I'm absolutely sure that you weren't the usual Shouko-san."
"I'm just thinking how you have become really cute in the short time we haven't seen each other, Shouko-san."
"…Gulp!? Cough… cough…!?"
"Did anything good happen? …Perhaps during winter break, you had a chance encounter with an amazing individual?"
"No, n-nothing like that… t-that's ridiculous."
"You've been telling me those kinds of things so directly up until now. But it's cute how all of a sudden you stammer like that, you know?"
"Like I said… There's no way anyone should've noticed…"
"If that was an act, then I give up… What do you say?"
"It was an act. I'm a prodigy at this, after all."
"To the point where you can deceive even yourself?"
"…Why are you insisting that there's some good in me here? If people manage to believe in the innocence of someone who's confessed their crimes, society can't function, you know?"
"That's a topic of the past. Your current confession doesn't prove anything."
"You see, I'm very pleased by the fact that I've managed to complete the script for my next public performance. I've managed to get a grasp of the personas of the three of you."
"There it is. You can't forgive me this time, huh?"
"Why do you think that we can't forgive you?"
"The plot is going to overwrite the foundations of the story. The resulting Haruki and Ogiso-san will be different from the ones I know."
"The plot…"
"The three of you were bound together by a strong connection in the past. A bond that's exclusive between the three of you, with no room for outsiders like me."
"Is it really that strong? …The bond we share, I mean."
"I have no intention of intervening in your real lives. It's just that until this play comes to an end, I want its authenticity to be preserved. I want to long for him, just like the heroine does."
"So hate me… detest me… But I'd like you to leave me alone this next month. It's not a very difficult request, is it?"
"Detesting you… I can't do that. Hating you… is definitely impossible for me."
"Setsuna!"
"Haruki-kun can definitely forgive you, you know?"
"Just how big of a masochist is he?"
"Because he knows both the pain of betraying and the grief of being betrayed. Whatever happens, he won't hate anyone. He won't blame anyone."
"He cried, you know? I deceived him and he screamed out in unbelievable agony."
"He might cry at first, but in the end, he'll forgive everything unconditionally. I'll even bet on it."
"Why?"
"…Because he still hasn't realized that's the worst punishment one could render to the other person, I think?"
"…I don't understand what you mean."
"You love Haruki-kun, don't you?"
"I don't see anything in a guy like him. I was simply using him from head to toe."
"And so, with those feelings of guilt, you can't move on anymore, right? Ah… yeah, I understand. I understand completely."
"Could you stop deciding things by yourself on a whim? Getting hit in the face once or twice would be much better compared to…"
"But I'm sorryーI also can't come to hate you. Thank you, Shouko-san. Despite all this, I was still saved by you."
"Why is everyone just…!"
"The reason I thought to persevere back then was all thanks to you. Because you encouraged me. Because you untangled the chains around my heart."
"But I ruined it all in the end."
"For two people to fall in love with the same person… things like that happen. I was broken like that three years ago."
"I told you that's not it! Don't think of me as some pitiful child!"
"Embracing a man who you don't even love isn't something you can do. …Especially not when another girl who loves him can't bring herself to do it."
"Why are you trying to apply a woman's common sense on me? Can you not understand what I've been telling you, Ogiso-san?"
"Yes, that was my intention… Did I misunderstand something?"
"Rather than asking what exactly you've misunderstood, I feel you should be asking if there's even anything you didn't misunderstand…"
"It seems like we aren't getting through to each other."
"…I'm done with this conversation. I'm leaving."
"Thanks for the bento. Truth be told, I was feeling really hungry."
"…You're trying to find the good in me again. You're making me hate you, you know?"
"…I'm sorry."
"Ugh… I should change my script. The way you are now, you're not the Ogiso Setsuna I knew from before."
"…You think so?"
"Strong, gentle… and yet so foolish, a woman like you. To not be honest with your own feelings even when things have come to this… I don't understand you at all."
"I wonder if that means we're in the same boat…?"
"At the very least, I really don't think it's like that."
"Hey, Chiaki-san…"
"What?"
"No matter how many roles you've managed to play, in the end, you're still just one woman, you know?"
"Farewell, Shouko-san. Thank you for everything up until now."
"It was painful. I… being betrayed by her… it just hurt so much…"
"Is that so…"
What I did to Setsuna as she turned around was not hold her in a tight embrace, nor did I expect to be spoiled by her.
I'm simply telling her the truth. I'm frankly confessing my newest sin to her.
"It's just like that Christmas night… just like when I parted with you, Setsuna. It feels so painful and sad."
"…Hmm?"
I'm telling Setsuna about how I've embraced another woman merely hours after I parted with her that night.
And I'm telling her about how I've spent ten days with that woman living together in my apartment after that.
I'm confessing about a cowardly betrayal that's the absolute worst. And I'm explaining the just desserts I'd brought upon myself as a result.
"That's why I'm sorry… I'm really sorry for you to have had to come over to my apartment… You really shouldn't be treating me so nicely."

Before I even have the time to ponder on whether what I'm doing is just, I simply reveal the truth to Setsuna. Perhaps I'm riding my decision on the excuse of being honest with her as the absolute worst form of escape.
"If you continue treating me so kindly, Setsuna, I might make the wrong decision again. I might repeat the same mistake again."
That's why Setsuna lets out an extremely bitter and miserable expression, as if to affirm my assumption.
Yet she maintains a composed tone as she begins to question me, even if I know that she's gritting her teeth on the inside.
"To choose me… do you think it's a mistake, Haruki-kun?"
"I don't know… I still haven't decided on anything yet."
"I haven't decided if I should not give up on you but to bring more painful memories on you, Setsuna, or to finally betray you and release you from your sadness…"
That's why I'm being so cruel.
"Or maybe… just maybe… I'll end up making the most ridiculous choice of all…"
"To choose… her?"
The third choice which I presented to Setsuna is completely meaningless to her. It simply reveals my selfishness in the situation.
"To have compared you with her and to have chosen her in the end, Setsuna… It's so idiotic that anyone in the world would question it, and yet…"
"So you're saying that I'm just that much of an unbearable existence to you, Haruki-kun…"
"I'm supposed to be the one who's an unbearable existence to you, Setsuna. I'm the plague that's caused suffering at its worst to your world."
"For you to think of things that way… I suppose it's my fault that you think of it that way, Haruki-kun…"
On the contrary, my words have caused Setsuna to feel guilty despite her not having done anything wrong. One could even say that my words toward her are no different than blades.
Why am I doing this…? Why?
I was already in seventh heaven when Setsuna came to visit me.
For time to have stopped like that, and if only it could stay still forever…
"And…"
"Hmm…?"
"And to have been able to treat her as a woman all this time. I guess I'm the only person in the world that's this gullible."
Why am I… talking about another woman right now?
Why am I so desperately defending such a vile betrayer?
"It seems that I still can't understand it. I guess my mind can't keep up at all due to my fever, huh…"
Yes, it must be because of my fever…
That I'm capable of nonchalantly telling these cruel things to Setsuna…
Even if a certain person would cackle in laughter and roll on the floor if she heard me, I'd find myself still capable of calmly spilling the beans after all.

"She's a prodigy, and she's cruel, heartless, immoral… and I know she's unquestionably dangerous as a woman or as a person. And despite all that, she's still an idiot, and to me, a good person, and my precious savior."
My current feelings are flowing out, completely unfiltered.
What am I doing, though…?
Even though I'm aware that I'm not someone indispensable to her…
Contrarily, she's been very hard to manage, even for me, to the point where I don't even know if I can do anything about it.
Could it be that I still love her? Could it be that I need her?
Or is it…
"The fact that she needed me… Over 99% of it was my misunderstanding, thinking about it now."
"I see… so that's how it is…"
"I don't know what you mean when you say 'so that's how it is,' Setsuna…"
"…Though I suppose that's how it is then."
"Uu-uu… uu… uu-gh…"
"Strong, gentle… and yet so foolish, a woman like you. To not be honest with your own feelings even when things have come to this… I don't understand you at all."
"Of course you wouldn't be able to understand…"
"After all… my acting was perfect, wasn't it?"
